attributes.description: Celestions rarely appear from the void. Their wings emit a strange energy, which absorbs objects that get too close.
Self sufficient and able to produce their own light, Solarions often live in solidarity
A Mangris will confuse its prey with floral appendages. Once it is near, its saw-like front legs strike at the speed of sound.
Sporeleons are often found perched high in the forest canopy, waiting for an unsuspecting meal to pass underneath.
Bazub swarms are both deadly and destructive and can destroy entire croplands in mere minutes
A Bolbon can be inactive for so long that moss, shrubs, or even small trees grow on their backs and limbs.
Nocterra spread halucinogenic pollens which can severely disorient travellers and predators.
Lycospores release clouds of fine particles that shut down the immune systems of other living things.
Floreans root themselves to the ground and become immovable objects. Their vines are stronger than threaded steel, and often it is easier to move the earth itself.
Koranok claws are powerful enough to burrow through permafrost and bedrock, where they build their nests in warm safety.
While swimming at full speed, a Sharakus generates enough energy to cause fifty-meter swells.
Sujin are mischevious tricksters that are able to shape their watery bodies at will to mimic anything they have already seen
Leviathans usually drift throughout the dark abyss, their maws held open like black holes in the sea.
The horns of Seaqueens are coated with a powerful toxin that can potentially paralyze a target or attacker for several days--if they survive the blow.
The Nagae have powerful, muscular bodies that enable them to manoeuvre swiftly and easily through water.
Despite not having bones, each tentacle on a Mermos is capable of crushing a rock to beach sand.
Glacioises move so slowly that they are often mistaken for part of the glaciar.
The wings of an Antarcticus emit a cold wind that cause dense clouds to erupt in snow.
Woovers travel in packs and chase down their prey over extremely long distances, or work together to set ambushes and traps.
Lavekans increase their elemental power when they are on firey ground, and often coil themselves up during combat to amplify that effect
When a Calidus senses a threat, it begins to burn white hot and emits heatwaves that melt swords and char spears to black.
Magmusii ooze a trail of lava wherever they go, which remains hot for many hours before cooling. This makes them easy to track in the wild--and even easier in cities.
Chargoyles usually nest in groups on the sides of volcanoes. Easily startled, their manes erupt with flames in sychronicity as they take wing.
A Firadactus heats the air under its wings to aid its flight, allowing it to soar for many days without rest.
When harmed or threatened, a Ignis emits a strong odor that alerts its hive to the presence of invaders. Soon, there are many buzzing flames and red hot stingers.
If threatened, Blazeos fan out their burning tails to shield themselves from attacks and obscure their image.
When a Phoenix sheds its feathers, the discarded plumage continues to burn until the end of its cycle, even if placed underwater.
A Flamus must always be on the move, lest it melts the ground it stands upon.
Goblens are social creatures that work in large groups. Although small, their voices carry over heat and can extend many miles in the right conditions.
Depedusae cause small earthquakes as they build their complex tunnel networks. They are believed to live at the bottom of the world's crust in perpetual heat, pressure, and darkness.
Whenever something dies near a Darthys, its soul risks being trapped in the crystal on the Darthys' back forever.
The claws of Wraiths are massive and terrifying, but their slash is the legend of stories, which put kids to bed in fear.
Wanderers are said to be powerful warrior spirits that travel the world in desperate search for a worthy opponent.
Baphomets are highly deceptive shapeshifters that commit to their disguises at great lengths, sometimes posing as another being for a full lifetime.
Because they have no desires of their own, Sentinels stand guard at attention indefinitely. They are the perfect soldiers.
The glowing gold antlers of Elkari are used for mating rituals and courtship combat. Elkari are sometimes found to be training against large boulders and can turn a mountainside to rubble.
Highly sensitive to the world and its vibrations, Lumeniciae communicate through photons of light.
Gryphons whip their tails to send shockwaves of air that stun and shatter with sound on impact.
Pegasusies gallop through the night sky, wherefore they are commonly mistaken for falling stars.
Templars have powerful wings that allow for sudden take-off and blurring flight. They cannot be caught--only trapped and befriended.
